verdict.rationale: Evidence shows BILL's broader platform (API and pricing page) supports AP capabilities — custom approval policies, purchase orders/2-way matching, AI invoice coding, and a 4M+ vendor network for payments — but these are documented under the general bill.com/developer.bill.com platform rather than clearly as native features of the 'Spend & Expense' product itself, and no evidence specifies ACH/check/wire payment method options. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that invoice capture, approval routing, and multi-method vendor payments (ACH/check/wire) are native to the Spend & Expense SKU (not a separate AP product), and independent/hands-on corroboration.
